comment: The exact third-party actions this repository may run, pinned to full commit SHAs. tests/ci/test-required-checks.sh fails if any workflow references an action outside this set, and the repository Actions restriction (github-security.md §6) is configured from this file. Verify each SHA against its repository tag/branch before updating.

actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e.purpose: Check out the PR or dispatch ref in every workflow.
actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e.credential_note: The pull_request workflow sets persist-credentials: false; dispatch workflows keep the default only where later steps need git operations (none currently push).

actions/setup-go@40f1582b2485089dde7abd9.purpose: Install Go for actionlint in the CI script checks job.

hashicorp/setup-terraform@b9cd54a3c349d3.credential_note: terraform_wrapper disabled; no cloud credentials are injected by this action.

dtolnay/rust-toolchain@b725eda525362e7cf.purpose: Rust toolchain for the release and frontend workflows (trusted dispatch/tag contexts only).
